config.comment.masaextraenabled: Master switch for all MasaExtra features.
config.comment.masaextrauseserverexact: Use the exact-placement protocol when the server supports it; disable to use only client-side geometry.
config.comment.masaextrarefreshgammaonjo: Re-apply Tweakeroo's gamma override after the first world join.
config.comment.masaextracooldownms: Litematica's same-position placement cache time. 0 disables it. Default 250ms.
config.comment.masaextrasuppressmissings: Cancel placement instead of letting Easy Place put a floor torch when the wall is missing.
config.comment.masaextrachatdebug: Print block state and block info to chat when Exact Place triggers.
config.comment.masaextradebugmode: Print diagnostic messages to the game log.
config.comment.masaextraommchighlightstr: OMMC highlightEntity: use strict entity id matching instead of substring matching, so 'item' no longer highlights item frames / item displays.
config.comment.easyplacev2protocolextra: Send the full block state through the easy place V2 protocol, so stairs, rails, trapdoors, levers, vines and similar blocks are placed in the exact schematic orientation instead of only facing.
config.comment.easyplacerailblocknoshape: After placing a rail, do not let it re-connect with neighbouring rails; keep the shape stored in the schematic.
config.comment.masaextrasnapalignenabled: While the configured trigger is active, snap your position to the centre of the block you stand on. Only applies while standing still.
config.comment.masaextrasnapaligntrigger: Snap aim: follow Tweakeroo's snap aim toggle. Hotkey: only while the hotkey below is held.
config.comment.masaextrasnapalignhotkey: Hold to snap your position to the centre of the block you stand on. Used when the snap trigger is set to Hotkey.
